title: Is Grand Theft Auto 6 simply too hot for the beauty industry to handle?
summary: The launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 has absolutely everyone talking – apart from beauty. But given that the cosmetics industry is no stranger to a controversial collaboration, why are brands so hesitant to pull the trigger on one of gaming's biggest launches of the decade? CB investigates
